title: Unit Advances on the Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line: Conditions and Limits
content:
**Rule.** A unit can be advanced only while the line status is active. The outstanding wholesale principal plus the new advance must not exceed the new-vehicle line plus the used-vehicle line, increased by the grade's over-line allowance percent for units already in transit from the factory. A new Kestrel unit is advanced at the grade's new-vehicle advance percent of factory invoice; a used unit at the grade's used-vehicle advance percent of wholesale book value and only up to the grade's used-vehicle age limit in years; no single advance may exceed the grade's single-unit advance limit without senior approval. Demonstrators may not exceed the grade's demonstrator percent of the new line, service loaners the grade's service loaner unit limit, and rental units are floored only where the grade allows rental units; invoices received after the funding cutoff time (Central Time) are funded the next business day.

A unit advance under the Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line floors one unit, identified by its VIN, and pays the advance to the manufacturer or seller. The advance adds to the line's outstanding wholesale principal, the balance that advances increase and payoffs and curtailments reduce.

## Conditions judged on the line's own record

Both gates are read from the system record of the line the advance is made on, as it stands before the advance, not from the dealer's description of it.

| Gate | Record read | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Line status | The status of that line | The status is active |
| Line room | That line's outstanding wholesale principal, new-vehicle line and used-vehicle line | Outstanding wholesale principal plus the new advance is no more than the new-vehicle line plus the used-vehicle line, that sum increased by the over-line allowance percent where the unit is already in transit from the factory |

Because the status gate says "only while active", a line that is pending documentation, on credit hold, in wind-down or closed takes no unit advance.

## Line room on hypothetical figures

Hypothetical line: new-vehicle line 1000000 USD, used-vehicle line 200000 USD, outstanding wholesale principal 1150000 USD; a hypothetical over-line allowance of 4 percent. These are illustrative inputs, not any grade's terms.

| Proposed advance | Unit already in transit from the factory | Principal plus advance | Ceiling | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 50000 USD | No | 1200000 USD | 1200000 USD | Within the line: equal to the ceiling does not exceed it |
| 60000 USD | No | 1210000 USD | 1200000 USD | Exceeds the line |
| 60000 USD | Yes | 1210000 USD | 1200000 USD increased by 4 percent, which is 1248000 USD | Within the line |

## Amount and kind of unit

- **New Kestrel unit**: the advance is the grade's new-vehicle advance percent of the factory invoice.
- **Used unit**: the advance is the grade's used-vehicle advance percent of wholesale book value, and the unit may be no older than the grade's used-vehicle age limit.
- **Any single unit**: an advance above the grade's single-unit advance limit requires senior approval.
- **Demonstrators**: the demonstrators floored may not exceed the grade's demonstrator percent of the new-vehicle line.
- **Service loaners**: no more service loaner units than the grade's limit may be floored.
- **Rental-fleet units**: floored only on a grade where rental units are allowed.

## Funding day

A factory invoice received by the funding cutoff time on a business day is funded that business day; an invoice received after the cutoff is funded the next business day.
